rules.label: Input safety
rules.setup: Guardrails → add Prompt Injection, action Block. Traces with stage=intake carry the raw RFQ.

rules.label: Spec match
rules.setup: Evaluators Hub → new evaluator on stage=line_match: 'Does the matched item's grade, form and size agree with the buyer's line? Flag any field that contradicts it.'

rules.label: Alternates policy
rules.setup: Knowledge Base → upload data/rudco/kb/standards.md so a dual-cert claim is grounded.

rules.label: Per-line margin floor
rules.setup: Alerts → rule on guardrail_blocks > 0 scoped to agent rudco-rfq-agent.

rules.label: Blended margin floor
rules.setup: Same alert as above; the gate trace names the blocking check.

rules.label: Account standing
rules.setup: Guardrails → Regex Pattern Match on output for 'credit_hold' to count holds.

rules.label: Compliance documents
rules.setup: Knowledge Base → upload compliance.md; add Off-Topic Detection grounded in the KB.

rules.label: Market benchmark
rules.setup: Upload benchmarks.md; evaluator: 'Is the stated $/lb inside the cited benchmark band?'
